name: DocLayNet: Human-Annotated Dataset for Document-Layout Analysis
description: DocLayNet is a large human-annotated dataset for document layout analysis. It contains 80,863 document pages across six core document categories (Financial Reports, Manuals, Scientific Papers, Laws & Regulations, Patents, and Government Documents) with bounding-box annotations across 11 layout classes.
